001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.inventory;
002
003import org.bukkit.block.Block;
004import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
005import org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack;
006import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
007
008/**
009 * Resolves a placed block to the inventory wrapper used by a QuickShop.
010 *
011 * <p>Providers are consulted by priority before QuickShop's Bukkit container fallback. A provider
012 * must not load chunks while checking support or creating a wrapper.</p>
013 */
014public interface ShopContainerProvider {
015
016  /**
017   * Gets this provider's resolution priority.
018   *
019   * @return the priority; greater values are resolved first
020   */
021  default int priority() {
022
023    return 0;
024  }
025
026  /**
027   * Checks whether this provider owns the supplied block.
028   *
029   * @param block the candidate shop block
030   * @return whether this provider supports it
031   */
032  boolean supports(@NotNull Block block);
033
034  /**
035   * Gets the manager used to persist and later locate this provider's wrappers.
036   *
037   * @return the registered wrapper manager
038   */
039  @NotNull
040  InventoryWrapperManager getInventoryWrapperManager();
041
042  /**
043   * Creates a wrapper for the supplied block.
044   *
045   * @param block the supported block
046   * @return its inventory wrapper
047   * @throws IllegalArgumentException when the block is no longer supported
048   */
049  @NotNull
050  InventoryWrapper createInventoryWrapper(@NotNull Block block) throws IllegalArgumentException;
051
052  /**
053   * Performs a provider-specific access check during shop creation.
054   *
055   * @param player the player creating the shop
056   * @param block the supported block
057   * @return whether creation is allowed
058   */
059  default boolean canCreateShop(@NotNull final Player player, @NotNull final Block block) {
060
061    return true;
062  }
063
064  /**
065   * Resolves the item stored on a newly created shop.
066   *
067   * <p>Virtual containers may use this hook to replace the player's requested item with the
068   * container's canonical registered item. The returned stack controls item matching for the
069   * shop, while its amount controls the trade stack size.</p>
070   *
071   * @param block the supported shop block
072   * @param requestedItem the item selected by the player
073   * @return the item QuickShop should store on the shop
074   */
075  @NotNull
076  default ItemStack resolveShopItem(
077          @NotNull final Block block,
078          @NotNull final ItemStack requestedItem) {
079
080    return requestedItem.clone();
081  }
082
083  /**
084   * Controls whether QuickShop may write its optimization marker to the physical block state.
085   *
086   * <p>External providers default to {@code false} because updating a foreign tile state may
087   * overwrite plugin-owned data such as player-head textures.</p>
088   *
089   * @return whether the block marker may be written
090   */
091  default boolean allowsBlockMarker() {
092
093    return false;
094  }
095}
